introduction: New Mexico Legal Aid accepts requests for civil legal help online and through its statewide intake line. Tell staff about any approaching court hearing or response deadline.
description: New Mexico Legal Aid accepts requests for civil legal help online and through its statewide intake line. Tell staff about any approaching court hearing or response deadline.

sections.who: The organization screens eligibility, legal issue and available capacity. Its service area covers New Mexico, with most of San Juan County handled by partner DNA People’s Legal Services.
sections.get: Services can range from information and advice to limited assistance or representation. An intake submission does not itself confirm that a lawyer will handle the case.
sections.docs:
• Notices, court papers or benefit decisions.
  • A short timeline and the next deadline.
  • Relevant agreements and correspondence.
  • Income and household information for screening.
sections.apply:
1. Start intake

    Use Apply for Legal Help or call 833-545-4357.

  2. Check current availability

    The contact page lists limited Monday–Thursday intake. Published pages differ on exact hours, so check before relying on a particular time.

  3. Confirm the next step

    Ask what assistance is accepted and whether a local office or partner will follow up.
sections.after: Keep the response and continue tracking deadlines. Ask for another legal provider if the case cannot be accepted.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using NMLA services and online intake, Current contact and limited phone intake, Local offices and partner coverage. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Yes. Its current homepage links an online legal-help application.
Does every county use the same local office?
No. Check the office directory; most of San Juan County is directed to DNA People’s Legal Services.
Is a submission a guarantee of representation?
No. Ask the provider to confirm the service it agrees to provide.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
